presets.name: Scream edge
presets.desc: A screamed lead that stays intelligible: chest boom cut before the dirt, sibilants kept clean, level even
presets.notes: The voice default: Single band (no dispersion in the ears), Tube grit with Fuzz waiting on the morph; comp 40 % holds the take

presets.name: Scream swell
presets.desc: The louder the scream, the more it breaks up: the envelope raises the drive and morphs Soft into Fuzz
presets.notes: Sung quietly it stays nearly clean; the dynamics of the voice play the dirt

presets.name: Growl split
presets.desc: Metal growl: chest clean and solid, a rasped body, no fizz on top
presets.notes: The clean-lows split of bass rigs, for voice; Three bands turn the phase 163° at the crossover: heard as a hollow chest in in-ears

presets.name: Parallel grit
presets.desc: A distorted layer blended under the clean voice, phase-aligned, so the words stay readable
presets.notes: Mix 35 %: the dry carries the words, the wet carries the edge; the guard's cap follows the mix

presets.name: Acoustic megaphone
presets.desc: A shout through a cone: thin mid honk, clipped, with a slap off the street
presets.notes: The acoustic horn with no amplifier; the electronic megaphone is a gfx-radio device

presets.name: Shout in a can
presets.desc: Shouting into a can taped to a cheap mic: the can's resonant peaks clip first
presets.notes: Box → Dirt: the object before the clipper, so its peaks are what distorts

presets.name: String phone
presets.desc: The child's can telephone: thin, ringing, barely dirty
presets.notes: Position 30 % moves the ear toward the closed end; the low cut takes the body away

presets.name: Bucket head
presets.desc: Singing with a bucket over the head: a boxy low resonance around the voice
presets.notes: Box 70 % keeps some direct sound for the consonants

presets.name: Bottle ghost
presets.desc: A hollow, haunted whisper inside a bottle, half dry, with a long dark slap
presets.notes: The bottle's 108 Hz Helmholtz peak is its loudest point: the guard counts it, raise the threshold on a loud stage

presets.name: Oil drum boom
presets.desc: A voice from inside a steel drum: a long metallic boom under a warm grit
presets.notes: The comp after the box holds the drum's resonant peaks note to note

presets.name: Glass jar sweep
presets.desc: A glassy formant sweep: the expression pedal moves the ear inside a jar
presets.notes: Put the EXP pedal on position (0 – 100 %): the notches sweep through the jar's mode series

presets.name: Cupped hands blues
presets.desc: The cupped bullet-mic voice of a harmonica player, put on a singer: midrange bark and grit
presets.notes: Carbon is the old-mic second-harmonic grain; the hands are a small Helmholtz cavity around 500 Hz

presets.name: Robot ring
presets.desc: The robot: a ring-modulated voice that turns into a sampled edge as the morph rises
presets.notes: Decimate's half-hold delay combs against the ring when they blend: part of the sound

presets.name: Broken transmission
presets.desc: A voice that drops out and sputters on loud syllables, through a cardboard box and a narrow band
presets.notes: Louder syllables morph into the starving rail; quiet ones fall into the sputter's dead zone

presets.name: Object morph
presets.desc: One pedal sweep turns a small can into an oil drum and soft grit into folding
presets.notes: Put the EXP pedal on morph (0 – 100 %); Fold's own law stops at 24 dB, so the sweep never turns to noise

presets.name: Drum bus crush
presets.desc: Parallel crushed drums in a box, the kick's body kept clean underneath
presets.notes: Guard and de-fizz off: a drum bus has no stage bleed through this block, and cymbals read as sibilants

presets.name: Can lead guitar
presets.desc: A fuzz solo through a tin can, the low strings kept clean
presets.notes: Morph toward Sine Fold for an octave-up shimmer on the top notes
